purpose: Bind the existing DreamLedger economic substrate into one reproducible 777 cell without creating a new ledger, queue, orchestrator, or truth system.

authority.elohim: creates/refines/repairs candidates and scorecards; never certifies economic truth
authority.cube: searches/compresses existing economic substrate; never certifies demand
authority.swarm: generates bounded populations of 5-10; internal computation only
authority.gauntlet: adversarially judges Elohim output and kills/blocks weak cells
authority.777: persistent experiment identity and attribution contract
authority.truth_oracle: public economic truth boundary; independent evidence required
authority.beck: immutable internal memory and attribution; never substitutes for external settlement
authority.telemetry: allocation signal; winners require observed evidence
authority.supervisor: delegates existing compute/runtime capacity only; no new queue or authority layer

proving_cell.success_condition: independent buyer + settled payment + fulfillment + evidence + attribution

recurring_surface.existing_machine: BUY -> STRIPE SUBSCRIPTION -> WEBHOOK -> ENTITLEMENT -> GATED TRUTH ORACLE ACCESS -> RENEW/REVOKE

truth_rules: internal generation never promotes itself to RESPONDED
synthetic or test events never count
settled payment alone is insufficient without attribution, fulfillment and evidence
